html_source: Early 20th century photograph of Hardwicke Street, the respectable street on the north side of Dublin on which Mrs. Mooney's boarding house is located, not far from St. George's church and the Blooms' house. Eason Photograph Collection of the National Library of Ireland. Source: mappingdubliners.org.
